corrections.why: Register gives 70 ft, which is 21.3 m. The 18.3 m figure equals 60 ft, the height in a 1936-37 forestry guide quoted on Forest Lookouts that does not name this site, so the 18.3 m figure may come from a different source.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says 70 ft (21.3 m). Forest Lookouts quotes a 1936-37 guide describing a 60-foot steel lookout tower without naming the site. Facts use the Register figure; the story reports the conflict.
Register says the CCC constructed the tower in 1937. Tennessee Encyclopedia gives 1937 and says probably the CCC. The story uses the hedged version.
Register gives 692 ft (211 m), matching the record's 210.9 m. tnlandforms lists 699 feet for the site; the record keeps the Register figure.

notes_for_editor: The Register is the only source with a height, a site visit and a registration date; the Encyclopedia gives the 1937 date with a hedge on the builder. The Forest Lookouts quote about a 60-foot tower is from a 1936-37 guide and does not name this site, so it is cited only as a conflict. The tnlandforms row reads Natchez Trace, 699', Henderson, FE2228 8-12 standing; its 699 figure differs from the Register's 692 ft by seven feet and is cited only as an inventory figure. Access: the Division of Forestry rule covers towers on state forests, while this tower is in the state park, so access is left out of facts. No closure notice for this tower was found. No staffing, fire history or photos found. Not verified: any tornado or storm damage to the tower and current condition.
